cases.sentence: Саулу было тридцать лет, когда он стал ___, и правил он Израилем сорок два года.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative after the verb стать requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Саул выбрал себе войска в Израиле три тысячи ___.
cases.explain: After numerals like 'три тысячи' (three thousand), the genitive plural is used.

cases.sentence: Две тысячи были с ним в городе Мехмасе и в Нагорьях Вефиля, а тысяча с его сыном Иоаннафаном в городе ___, что в земле Вениамина.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) when indicating direction requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иоаннафан напал на сторожевую заставу филистимлян в Геве, и филистимляне услышали об ___.
cases.explain: The preposition об (about) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: У них было три тысячи колесниц, шесть тысяч колесничих и столько воинов, сколько песка на ___.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) when governing location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Когда израилетяне увидели, что они в опасности, и что их сильно потеснили, они спрятались в пещерах и зарослях, среди скал, в ямах и ___.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location requires the prepositional case in the plural.

cases.sentence: Некоторые евреи даже перебрались за ___ в землю Гада и в Галаад.
cases.explain: The preposition за (beyond) requires the accusative case when indicating movement across.

cases.sentence: Во всей земле Израиля невозможно было отыскать ни одного кузнеца, потому что филистимляне сказали, иначе евреи станут делать ___ или копья.
cases.explain: The transitive verb делать requires the accusative case for its plural object.

reading.ru: Саулу было тридцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он Израилем сорок два года.
reading.question: How old was Saul when he became king, and how long did he reign?
options: He was thirty years old and reigned for forty-two years
He was forty years old and reigned for thirty years
He was twenty-five years old and reigned for fifty years
He was thirty-five years old and reigned for forty years
reading.correct: He was thirty years old and reigned for forty-two years
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Saul was thirty years old when he became king and reigned over Israel for forty-two years.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан напал на сторожевую заставу филистимлян в Геве, и филистимляне услышали об этом.
reading.question: What action did Jonathan take that alerted the Philistines?
options: He struck the garrison of the Philistines at Geba
He sent messengers to the elders
reading.correct: He struck the garrison of the Philistines at Geba
reading.explain: Jonathan struck (attacked) the Philistine garrison at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it.

reading.ru: Филистимляне собрались воевать с Израилем, у них было три тысячи колесниц, шесть тысяч колесничих и столько воинов, сколько песка на морском берегу.
reading.question: How powerful was the Philistine force that assembled?
options: They had thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore
They had ten thousand chariots and five thousand horsemen
They had fifty chariots and five hundred soldiers
They had only foot soldiers but no chariots
reading.correct: They had thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore
reading.explain: The text describes the massive Philistine force with thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and soldiers as numerous as sand.

reading.ru: Когда израилетяне увидели, что они в опасности, и что их сильно потеснили, они спрятались в пещерах и зарослях, среди скал, в ямах и колодцах.
reading.question: What did the Israelites do when they saw the Philistine force?
options: They hid in caves, thickets, rocks, holes, and cisterns
reading.correct: They hid in caves, thickets, rocks, holes, and cisterns
reading.explain: The Israelites, seeing the danger and being distressed, hid themselves in caves, thickets, rocks, holes, and cisterns.

reading.ru: Во всей земле Израиля невозможно было отыскать ни одного кузнеца, потому что филистимляне сказали, иначе евреи станут делать мечи или копья.
reading.question: Why were there no blacksmiths in all of Israel?
options: The Philistines wanted to prevent the Hebrews from making swords or spears
Blacksmiths had moved to other countries
reading.correct: The Philistines wanted to prevent the Hebrews from making swords or spears
reading.explain: No blacksmith could be found in Israel because the Philistines said otherwise the Hebrews might make swords or spears.

reading.ru: Поэтому в день сражения ни у одного воина с Саулом и Иоаннафаном не было в руке меча или копья.
reading.question: What was the consequence of the lack of blacksmiths on the day of battle?
options: None of the warriors with Saul and Jonathan had swords or spears in their hands
All the warriors had equal weapons
They used only bows and arrows
They were better armed than the Philistines
reading.correct: None of the warriors with Saul and Jonathan had swords or spears in their hands
reading.explain: Because of the Philistine control, on the day of battle, no warrior with Saul and Jonathan had a sword or spear in his hand.
